title: Malmgren saw video of the Roswell being interviewed
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren saw video of the Roswell being interviewed, about later in Malmgren's career at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Harold even told Pippa that later in his career, he saw the video of this creature being interviewed.
Malgm on his deathbed told Pipa, his daughter, that he saw an interview from one of the surviving beings from Roswell
tellings.difference: Places the telling on his deathbed and links the interview to the inspiration for Bluegill.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Harold Malmgren telling Pippa that he saw a video interview of a being that survived Roswell.

as_told.title: Malmgren's deathbed claim: taped interview with a Roswell alien that inspired Bluegill

tellings.quote: >> and he told her that he had seen an interview with the surviving or one of the surviving alien beings from Roswell
tellings.difference: Calls it a recorded interview with a surviving Roswell being, and the year is given as 1947.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Harold Malmgren telling Pippa on his deathbed that he saw an interview with a surviving Roswell being.

as_told.title: Malmgren's deathbed claim of a recorded interview with a surviving Roswell being
